purpose: Base capability measurement at 14B for slm-learning ladder extension. Per slm-learning-210, 3B regression (slm-learning-202) was a LoRA-recipe failure, not a base-capability failure; this rung measures the unmodified 14B base on the public-leaderboard slice (HE/MBPP) plus owned-domain (gad_tools) before any training spend is authorized.
fire_command_template: MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 modal run modal_app/eval_adapter.py::main --adapter-id BASE --base-model Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-14B-Instruct --benchmark {benchmark} --limit 164 --gpu A100 --persist-run-id eval-base-qwen-14b-coder-2026-05-09
fallback_quant: INT4 if A100-80GB unavailable on Modal; flag quality skew in the report and DO NOT compare INT4-vs-BF16 across rungs without footnote

pass_criteria.knee_candidate: HE >= 0.870 AND MBPP >= 0.840 (>= 7B Stein +2pp on both axes)
pass_criteria.promote_to_training_target: knee_candidate AND inference cost-per-task <= 1/4 of Opus on owned-domain row

preflight_notes: DO NOT FIRE without Dr. Stein authorization. Modal A100-80GB pricing must be reconfirmed before launch (Modal pricing drift). Confirm slm-models volume has free space; 14B BF16 weights are ~28GB on disk.
